name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: Person mark with photo or initials, optional presence, and a stacked overflow group.

api.description: Person mark with optional photo, generated initials fallback, presence tone, and a stacked overflow group.

props.name: name
props.description: Required display name. Drives initials, default title, default image label, and the tone color.

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL. Sanitized before load. On failure or omit, initials render instead.

props.name: alt
props.description: Accessible name for the loaded image. Defaults to name.

props.name: presence
props.description: Status dot tone. Omit to hide the dot. The dot has its own accessible name from the string catalogue.

groups.title: Accessibility
groups.description: Image name (alt): When src loads, the image uses alt (defaulting to name). Initials fallback is aria-hidden; the root title defaults to name and is not an ARIA name. Presence (status): The presence dot carries a catalogue aria-label for its tone.

props.name: items
props.description: People to show. Each item needs id and name; src and presence are optional.

props.name: max
props.description: How many faces to show before an overflow chip. The overflow chip announces how many more.

props.name: size
props.description: Size for every face and the overflow chip.

props.name: shape
props.description: Shape for every face and the overflow chip.
